 Sofía Vergara and Imagine Dragons singer Dan Reynolds hold hands in new photos from Beverly Hills dinner
 Reynolds and actress Minka Kelly ended their relationship in early October.
 © NBC 
 Daniel Neira Senior Writer OCTOBER 27, 2026 1:46 PM EDT OCT 27, 2026, 1:46 PM EDT 
 Sofía Vergara and Dan Reynolds  have sparked romance speculation after new photos showed them holding hands across the table during dinner at Cipriani in Beverly Hills over the weekend.
 You may also like Sofia Vergara pairs an unexpected rock-inspired fashion staple with a chic luxury accessory

 The 'Modern Family' actress smiled broadly as she reached toward the Imagine Dragons singer, who held her hand while they chatted. The photographs captured the two seated opposite each other, with beauty entrepreneur and longtime Vergara friend Anastasia Soare beside the actress.
 © Byline: NGRE/BACKGRID/GROSBY GROUP Sofia Vergara was spotted enjoying late-night dinner date with newly single Imagine Dragons frontman Dan Reynolds at Cipriani in Beverly Hills. 
 It was reported that Vergara and Reynolds later left through the restaurant’s back entrance at approximately 12:30 am with their group of friends.
 While the affectionate interaction has drawn attention, a source offered a more casual explanation. Speaking to People, the insider described the outing as “a friendly group dinner.” 
 © Byline: NGRE/BACKGRID/GROSBY GROUP It was reported that Vergara and Reynolds later left through the restaurant’s back entrance at approximately 12:30 am with their group of friends. 
 Dan Reynolds’ recent split from Minka Kelly:
 The dinner comes shortly after reports that Reynolds and actress Minka Kelly had ended their relationship. News of their breakup emerged earlier this month, following nearly four years together. They were first publicly linked in late 2022.
 © Byline: NGRE/BACKGRID/GROSBY GROUP Sofía Vergara and Dan Reynolds’s hand-holding moment sparked speculation about a possible romance. 
 Although the pair generally kept their relationship private, Kelly shared occasional glimpses of their life together. Over the summer, she posted photographs from a Disneyland visit with Reynolds and his children, offering a rare look at their time as a family.
 Reynolds was previously married to musician Aja Volkman, with whom he shares four children. Arrow, twins Gia and Coco, and Valentine. The former couple married in 2011, separated in 2022, and finalized their divorce in March 2024.
 © Byline: NGRE/BACKGRID/GROSBY GROUP Sofía Vergara smiles as she holds hands with Dan Reynolds across the table at Cipriani in Beverly Hills. 
 Sofía Vergara’s relationships since her marriage ended:
 Vergara’s personal life has also attracted attention since she and Joe Manganiello announced their separation in July 2023. The actors married in November 2015, and their divorce was finalized in 2024.
 © Byline: NGRE/BACKGRID/GROSBY GROUP The actress and the Imagine Dragons singer chat during an evening out with friends. 
 Following the separation, Vergara began dating orthopedic surgeon Justin Saliman. They were first linked in October 2023, and she later shared affectionate posts about him, including a photograph of the doctor helping her recover from knee surgery in April 2024.
 By January 2025, however, Vergara appeared to indicate that she was single again when she included finding a boyfriend among her wishes for the new year. Her latest outing with Reynolds has renewed interest in her dating life, although the nature of their connection remains unconfirmed.
